scope: B30 Matcher start to running-complete; includes real provider preparation and awaited delivery; not exact gateway reception/send ACK timing; different live users/commands are not classified
privacy: Only timestamps and aggregate durations retained; no account IDs, messages, scores or image contents
known_send_path: QQ file_image -> post_group_files/post_c2c_files (media upload) -> post_group_messages/post_c2c_messages (send); stages awaited serially by installed adapter
limitation: No per-request upload/send or real SQL stage measurements exist in this release. Do not attribute the remaining duration to a particular phase without additional instrumentation.
